title: Continuity status store and Nostr read-model projector
intent: Expose current service continuity status to local readers and relay-visible Nostr read models without adding polling, request/response wrappers, or DNS/projector hot-file changes.
scope: Add an in-memory ContinuityStatus store keyed by service key.
Project continuity status runtime events to Nostr kinds 30351, 30352, and 30353 through an injected publish function.
Apply the requested 30351 idempotency rule for active profile, operation state, active worker, run ID, and current step tuple.
out_of_scope: Adapter-level kind constants and signing implementation.
DNS projector wiring and endpoint cutover behavior.
Continuity recipe execution and trigger evaluation.
